workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID written by the first `enbu init`. The storage must hold the same UUID. Do not edit.

control_genesis.description: Digest of the workspace's first signed member list: the trust root every device verifies against. Written by the first `enbu init`. Never edit it.

default_env.description: The team's default environment, used until a person runs `enbu switch`. Defaults to "default" if omitted.

storage.description: Where the signed ciphertext is stored.

plain_http.description: Use HTTP for a local OCI registry.

env.description: Environment definitions. Each key is the environment name. Omit entirely to use only the "default" environment.

output.description: Output file path for this environment. Defaults to .env.{name} (or .env for the "default" environment).

incarnation.description: Where this environment's secrets are stored. `enbu switch -c` writes it; keep it when editing. An environment without one is stored under its name.
